notes: The 18 skills of 5e (SRD). Designer change: Intimidation uses STR by default (DMG variant Strength (Intimidation)); individual checks may override the ability later.

entries.name: Acrobatics
entries.description: Keeping your footing on ice, rope bridges and rocking decks, and tumbling clear of a fall.

entries.name: Animal Handling
entries.description: Calming, driving and caring for horses, mules and other beasts that carry the party and its goods.

entries.name: Arcana
entries.description: Recognising spells, magical items and arcane hazards, and judging what enchanted goods are worth.

entries.name: Athletics
entries.description: Climbing, swimming, hauling heavy loads and forcing a cart through mud or a blocked pass.

entries.name: Deception
entries.description: Bluffing past tolls and guards, passing off goods as better than they are, and keeping a straight face.

entries.name: History
entries.description: Knowing the past of the lands, ruins, noble houses and old trade routes the party passes through.

entries.name: Insight
entries.description: Reading a trader's true intent, spotting a lie, and sensing when a deal or a stranger is wrong.

entries.name: Intimidation
entries.description: Backing down bandits, hagglers and thugs with a show of force or a threat they believe.

entries.name: Investigation
entries.description: Searching for clues, finding hidden compartments, and working out what happened at an abandoned camp.

entries.name: Medicine
entries.description: Treating wounds and sickness on the road and judging whether food and water are safe.

entries.name: Nature
entries.description: Knowing plants, beasts, weather and terrain, and which wild goods are valuable or dangerous.

entries.name: Perception
entries.description: Noticing ambushes, tracks, landmarks and anything out of place on the road or in town.

entries.name: Performance
entries.description: Entertaining a crowd with music, stories or show to earn coin, goodwill or a free night's lodging.

entries.name: Persuasion
entries.description: Haggling fair prices, winning favours, and talking people into helping through honest argument and charm.

entries.name: Religion
entries.description: Knowing gods, rites, shrines and holy orders, and dealing respectfully with the faithful.

entries.name: Sleight of Hand
entries.description: Picking pockets, palming small goods, and hiding contraband from inspectors.

entries.name: Stealth
entries.description: Slipping past patrols and monsters unseen, and moving the party and its cargo quietly.

entries.name: Survival
entries.description: Finding the way, foraging, tracking, and making a safe camp in the wilds.
